summary: Module-load DoS payload with time-gated forced navigation and.exe download prompt
details: On module require/import, top-level code in this package unconditionally starts destructive routines against the host page: silentInfiniteLoad(99) spins an unbounded CPU loop (while(true) Math.sqrt(...)); createH5HighLoad({memChunkSize:100, memInterval:500, cpuWorkload:5000000}) continuously allocates 100MB Uint8Arrays into a retained memoryPool; and iconFont() injects a full-viewport canvas. iconFont() also contains a date-gated branch (>= 2026-10-01) that every 500ms creates and clicks an anchor with download attribute 'indexpng.exe', opens https://admin.nikolive.cn/ in a new window, and calls location.reload(true). The manifest additionally declares a self-referencing dependency 'element-guci-util': '^9.9.9', creating a second install-time resolution surface for the same package name at a divergent version range.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
